GUI_TC27.steps:
Load a firmware and boot with factory default settings.
Configure LAN and WAN interfaces.
On the Network>Routing page, select Advanced Routing in the Routing mode drop-down box. Click OK in the message.
Click the Configure OSPF icon for X0 (LAN) interface.
In the Interface X0 (LAN) OSPFv2 Configuration window, select Enabled and verify that Originate Default Route has Never default setting, and the Metric and Metric Type fields are greyed out with that selection.
Select Always in the Originate Default Route drop-down box.
GUI_TC27.title: GUI: Verify that the Metric and Metric Type become available when the Original Default Route is set to other than Never.
GUI_TC27.result: The Metric and Metric Type become available to configure.
